svg.aria-label: Indirect routing for a mobile device: a correspondent sends to the device's permanent home address; the home network forwards (tunnels) packets to the visited network, which delivers them to the device; the device can reply directly. Cellular networks keep the device's IP anchored at the gateway in the same way.
